title: Multi-phase trial credit orchestration + enterprise security-questionnaire readiness
creator: Ava Singh
description:
Goal: improve free-to-paid conversion while reducing waste from low-intent credit usage, and at the same time make enterprise procurement smoother by producing a pre-filled security questionnaire bundle for trial customers.

Hypothesis: A multi-phase trial (large initial discover credits + follow-up engagement credits unlocked by product activity) with staggered expirations will increase meaningful activation (reach of 3+ API calls + embeddings usage) and increase paid upgrades by 12% relative to current flat 30-day credit grants. Separately, providing an out-of-the-box security questionnaire packet and a standard contract addendum for trial-to-enterprise transitions will reduce legal procurement time by ~30% and increase sales-accepted trial handoffs.

Experiment design (high level):
- Variant A (control): current single grant 25,000 token-credit, 30-day expiry, standard UI upsell.
- Variant B: initial 5,000 credit immediate + 20,000 engagement credits unlocked when user hits activation events (first embedding OR first streaming generate), expiry: initial credits 14d, unlocked credits 45d.
- Variant C: large upfront 50,000 credit, expiry 7d with in-product nudges showing remaining credits and suggested sample prompts.
- All variants instrumented for: activation events, time-to-first-paid, conversion funnel, credit burn rate, retention at D7/D30, cost-per-conversion.

Enterprise/security parallel scope:
- Create a security-questionnaire bundle: completed SIG Lite, SOC2 summary one-pager, KMS/HSM architecture doc, retention/encryption answers. Template to be hosted in Drive + linked from trial UI for customer self-serve download.
- Create a contract addendum template for trial customers that expedites Dedicated/Private onboarding (standard SLAs, data handling, trial-to-paid credit reconciliation).

Success metrics: 12% relative increase in upgrade rate (free->paid) for variants B or C at 30 days; 20% reduction in procurement latency for enterprise trials where the questionnaire bundle is used; maintain or reduce median cost-per-conversion.

Rollout plan: 2-week ramped A/B test with 10k new trial signups per arm target across global regions. If one variant reaches p<0.05 on conversion lift and cost-per-conversion acceptable, we prepare rollout + pricing update doc.

Risks & mitigations:
- Large upfront credits (C) could be exploited by low-value bots -> mitigate with phone/email verification + rate-limits + early fraud detection.
- Unlock gating (B) requires reliable event tracking -> ENG dependency to ensure idempotency of activation events and server-side hooks.
- Legal/Procurement: bundle may need redactions for certain enterprise customers -> provide contact-sales CTA and on-demand full questionnaire answers.
